Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:12:00 +02:00
Subject: EU-only processing confirmation and VPC peering question

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week. Medica is moving toward a proof-of-concept and our security team has two immediate asks before we can progress to procurement:

1) Can Redwood commit to EU-only processing for all customer payloads for a pinned model? We need contractual language and an operational description of how you enforce this (routing, region-locked model variants, audit logs).

2) We require VPC-style private connectivity (peering or Private Connect) so that egress paths do not traverse public internet segments. Is VPC peering available for hosted customers in your EU region, and what the ops runbook looks like for establishing this?

Also our security team has a short SIG/CAIQ and a DPIA checklist. Can you provide an accelerated responses bundle (SOC2 evidence, SIG responses, and a DPIA outline) and indicate where we should send the procurement questionnaire?

Regards,
Lena
Lena Bauer
Security Lead — Medica Health GmbH

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: EU-only processing confirmation and VPC peering question

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can commit to EU-only processing for pinned models and we support private connectivity options in the EU region. Below I’ve sketched the operational controls and next steps; attaching a short plan and I’ve looped in Marissa and Neha for evidence and contractual language.

Operational summary:
- Geo-fencing: Requests to pinned model endpoints are scoped to EU region clusters. We enforce routing via our Smart Routing layer and region-locked model variants; requests that originate outside EU IP ranges are rejected when EU-only mode is enabled.
- Auditability: We keep request-level routing logs and retention metadata (token-free logs for up to 90 days by default; longer retention configurable under enterprise plans).
- Private connectivity: We offer VPC peering for Dedicated and a Private Connect option for hosted customers in EU regions. Onboarding involves a network pre-check, peering configuration (BGP or static), and an ops runbook with maintenance windows.

Requested artifacts we will provide this week:
- SIG/CAIQ answers (redacted where needed) — Marissa will lead.
- SOC 2 summary and attestation excerpt — Neha to attach.
- DPIA outline tailored to a POC (data flows, risk register, mitigation controls) — I’ll draft and share.

Next steps / asks from Medica:
- Confirm whether you require physical-only EU residency (no controls accessible from outside EU) or contractual EU-only processing is sufficient.
- Please send the procurement questionnaire to procurement@redwood.ai so we can route to procurement and legal.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Lena / Medica team — attaching the evidence bundle and suggested contractual language as requested. Summary below and attached files.

What we attached:
- Redwood-SIG-accelerated-response.pdf — per-question SIG/CAIQ answers, redacted where necessary, with cross-references to SOC2 artifacts.
- DPIA-outline-Medica-v1.docx — draft DPIA outline (data flows, high-level risk register, recommended mitigations).
- VPC-peering-guide.md — what to expect for peering, sample IP ranges, and maintenance windows.

Contract highlights we propose to add to the DPA (suggested wording):
- Data Processing Location: Customer data processed via pinned model endpoints will be processed exclusively within the European Economic Area (EEA) for the term of the agreement, except as necessary for emergency operations or subpoena responses; any such exceptional access will be logged and notified to the customer within 72 hours.
- Subprocessors: Redwood will list subprocessors with region; any subprocessor outside EEA used for the Customer’s pinned model will require prior written consent.
- Audit and Logs: Customer will have the right to request routing and processing logs (token-free) once per quarter; Redwood will provide redacted routing logs under NDA.

Cost estimate (high-level):
- One-time peering onboarding: €6,500 (includes runbook, network validation, and initial config)
- Monthly private connectivity fee: €1,200/month

Technical contact for DPIA: jonas_weber@redwood.ai (network & infra lead). Suggested review window: 3-5 business days to approve data flow diagram.

Let us know if you want a redline DPA — legal can prepare a short addendum that includes the EU-only processing clause. We can also run a scoped DPIA workshop next week.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
